item.title: No. 3 Michigan beats No. 7 Michigan State 83-71, takes sole possession of 1st place in Big Ten
item.description: EAST LANSING, Mich. — Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 points and 12 rebounds, Elliot Cadeau scored 17 and Morez Johnson added 12 points to lead No. 3 Michigan to an 83-71 victory over seventh-ranked Michigan State on Friday night.

item.title: High school basketball: Ottawa Hills boys outlast Toledo Christian
item.description: The Ottawa Hills boys basketball team went on the road on Friday and earned a hard-fought 44-38 win against Toledo Christian in Toledo Area Athletic Conference action.

item.title: Suns sweep back-to-back, ending Cavaliers' winning streak at 5 with 126-113 victory
item.description: PHOENIX — Dillon Brooks scored 27 points and the Phoenix Suns beat Cleveland 126-113 on Friday night to sweep a back-to-back and end the Cavaliers' winning streak at a season-best five games.

item.title: Huge cache of Epstein documents includes emails financier exchanged with wealthy and powerful
item.description: WASHINGTON — A huge new tranche of files on millionaire financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein released Friday revealed details of his communications with the wealthy and powerful, some not long before he died by suicide in 2019.

item.title: Senate passes Trump-backed government funding deal, sending to House
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted Friday to fund most of the government through the end of September while carving out a temporary extension for Homeland Security funding, giving Congress two weeks to debate new restrictions on federal immigration raids across the country.

item.title: Thousands face another arctic blast without power as East Coast preps for a storm
item.description: BELZONI, Miss. — Frustrations were bubbling up Friday for the tens of thousands who have been without power for nearly a week in the U.S. South as a new storm looms, including Tennessee's residents in Nashville, where the utility was criticized for storm preparations and recovery.

item.title: To the editor: Buckeye State holds key to a Republican majority in ’26
item.description: Northwest Ohio doesn’t see itself as the center of American politics. We’re builders, growers, and doers, not cable news-obsessed or Washington insiders.

item.title: Editorial: Gun availability a problem
item.description: The quarterly crime report from Toledo’s mayor and chief of police this week revealed a stubbornly high number of homicides while other crimes appeared to be on the decline.

item.title: To the editor: Candidate should solve, not worsen problems
item.description: Former State Rep. Elliot Forhan’s comments about “killing Donald Trump” do not represent democratic values. It is a disgrace to advocate the use of the judicial process to kill the President.

item.title: Cade Cunningham leads Pistons past Warriors 131-124 with 29 points, 11 assists
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO — Cade Cunningham had 29 points and 11 assists and the Detroit Pistons jumped to a big lead early before holding off the Golden State Warriors for a 131-124 win Friday night.
